parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: EITHER: $x^2-6x+k=7-2x\to x^2-4x+k-7\ (=0)$ — *M1. Guidance: Equates and collects terms. Use of $b^2-4ac=0\ (16-4(k-7)=0)$ — DM1. Guidance: Correct use of discriminant $=0$, involving $k$ from a 3-term quadratic. OR: $2x-6=-2\to x=2\ (y=3)$ — *M1. Guidance: Equates their $\frac{dy}{dx}$ to $\pm2$, finds a value for $x$. $(\text{their }3)$ or $7-2(\text{their }2)=(\text{their }2)^2-6(\text{their }2)+k$ — DM1. Guidance: Substitutes their value(s) into the appropriate equation. $\to k=11$ — A1. Total: 3.
